incoming.fix: Rewrite the Flag and the debug_cmd text: WP-14 always sends `Z:\` paths, and WP-15's `to_win_path` leaves those unchanged, so the contract holds either way. Quoting rule: the injector path, the stem and each --dll value are single-quoted (`'` becomes `'"'"'`); `--exe`, `--delay`, `--dll` and the delay digits stay bare. Example: `'/…/flat3d-uevr-inject.exe' --exe 'SWZeroCompany' --delay 15 --dll 'Z:\…\openxr_loader.dll' --dll 'Z:\…\UEVRBackend.dll'`.
